decisions.reason: Because it is close to the firm's established offering and has no reported shortfall against aspirations, slack supports keeping it while its compliance product line consolidates.
As the stated flagship and direction of the firm, it is central to aspirations and has high visibility, so the probability of dropping it is very low.
It leverages existing managed-hosting capabilities and is presented as a standard product, so without performance below aspiration the firm is likely to keep it.
